note: One real exchange with mcp/server.mjs over stdio, recorded by mcp/record.mjs against the evidence files of this build. The answer text is JSON; it is shown parsed here.

tools.name: search_evidence
tools.description: Search VESTA's verified findings (verbatim NASA quotes and PSI table findings) on spacecraft fire safety. Every word of `query` must appear in the claim or the quote. Returns no_source when nothing matches; VESTA never answers without a source.

tools.name: rank_evidence
tools.description: Rank the verified findings for a cabin and a concern with the published VESTA score (pillar 30, atmosphere 25, gravity 15, level 15, material 10, habitat 5). Each result carries its score parts, its coverage status at that cabin (PROVEN or EXTRAPOLATED) and the reasons. Oxygen, pressure and gravity default to the preset of the habitat.

tools.name: check_design
tools.description: Place a cabin (oxygen, pressure, gravity) on the map of what is in VESTA's evidence base (24 PSI investigations). Returns, per axis, how many cabin-material test rows sit at that value, and one cell per material and concern marked PROVEN (tested at these conditions), EXTRAPOLATED (evidence exists, a condition differs) or NEVER_TESTED, with reasons and the nearest test. Status is evidence coverage, not a safety certification.

tools.name: get_finding
tools.description: Fetch one record by id: a finding (for example S-VENT-01) with its verbatim quote, the rest of its sentence, its gated conditions and its source link; or a PSI test row (for example PSI-25:1) with its normalised fields and its raw table cells.
